mapper.select: SELECT S.SBJCT_ID , S.SBJCTNM , S.SBJCT_EXPLN , S.SBJCT_TYCD , S.LCTR_GBNCD , S.DVCLAS_NO , S.DVCLAS_NCKNM , S.USEYN , S.SBJCT_YR , S.SBJCT_SMSTR , S.CRCLMN_NO , NVL(CM.ORG_ID, CHRT.ORG_ID) AS ORG_ID , O.ORGNM AS ORG_NM , LC.LOW_FILE_NM , LC.HIGH_FILE_NM , NVL(LC.TOTAL_PLAY_SEC, 0) AS TOTAL_PLAY_SEC , FLOOR(NVL(LC.TOTAL_PLAY_SEC, 0) / 60) AS PLAY_MIN , MOD(NVL(LC.TOTAL_PLAY_SEC, 0), 60) AS PLAY_SEC FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT S LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CRS_MSTR CM ON CM.CRS_MSTR_ID = S.CRS_MSTR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT CHRT ON CHRT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ORG O ON O.ORG_ID = NVL(CM.ORG_ID, CHRT.ORG_ID) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT W.SBJCT_ID /* TB_LMS_LCTR_CONTS에는 저화질/고화질 파일명 컬럼이 확인되지 않아 데이터 출처가 확정될 때까지 화면에서는 '-'로 표시하도록 null 유지. */ , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(200)) AS LOW_FILE_NM , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(200)) AS HIGH_FILE_NM , SUM(NVL(C.VDO_MNTS, 0) * 60) AS TOTAL_PLAY_SEC FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL W JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR L ON L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID AND NVL(L.DELYN, 'N') = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_CONTS C ON C.LCTR_ID = L.LCTR_ID AND NVL(C.DELYN, 'N') = 'N' WHERE NVL(W.DELYN, 'N') = 'N' GROUP BY W.SBJCT_ID ) LC ON LC.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID WHERE S.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND S.DELYN = 'N'

SELECT S.SBJCT_ID , S.DVCLAS_NO , S.DVCLAS_NCKNM FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT S WHERE S.DELYN = 'N' AND NVL(S.CRS_MSTR_ID, S.SBJCT_ID) = ( SELECT NVL(B.CRS_MSTR_ID, B.SBJCT_ID) FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT B WHERE B.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND B.DELYN = 'N' ) ORDER BY S.DVCLAS_NO

SELECT B.EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC_ID AS QUIZ_ID , B.QSTN_TTL AS QUIZ_TTL , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(7, 0)) AS QUIZ_SEC FROM TB_LMS_EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC B WHERE B.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND B.DELYN = 'N' AND B.QSTN_GBNCD = 'SURPRISE_QUIZ' ORDER BY B.REG_DTTM DESC

SELECT B.EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC_ID AS QUIZ_ID , B.QSTN_TTL AS QUIZ_TTL , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(7, 0)) AS QUIZ_SEC , Q.QSTN_ID AS QSTN_ID , Q.QSTN_SEQNO AS QSTN_SEQNO , Q.QSTN_RSPNS_TYCD AS QSTN_RSPNS_TYCD , Q.QSTN_TTL AS QSTN_TTL , DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(Q.QSTN_CTS, 4000, 1) AS QSTN_CTS , Q.CRANS_EXPLN AS CRANS_EXPLN , V.QSTN_VWITM_ID AS QSTN_VWITM_ID , V.QSTN_VWITM_SEQNO AS QSTN_VWITM_SEQNO , V.QSTN_VWITM_CTS AS EX_CTS , V.CRANS_YN AS CRANS_YN FROM TB_LMS_EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC B LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_QSTN Q ON Q.EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC_ID = B.EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC_ID AND Q.DELYN = 'N' AND Q.QSTN_GBNCD = 'SURPRISE_QUIZ' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_QSTN_VWITM V ON V.QSTN_ID = Q.QSTN_ID WHERE B.EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC_ID = #{quizId} AND B.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND B.DELYN = 'N' AND B.QSTN_GBNCD = 'SURPRISE_QUIZ' ORDER BY Q.QSTN_SEQNO, V.QSTN_VWITM_SEQNO
